Aa

Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Kitchen, meals & drinks

salty adjective

also salted, salt (adjective), too salty, briny

classical

Ter. Ad. 425: Hoc salsum est
Plaut. Cas. 222: neque salsum neque suāve esse potest quicquam, ubi amor nōn admiscētur

salsus, salsa, salsum

declension

salted, salt, salty

The participle of saliō, to salt. Of talk it means witty, as sāl means wit.

Examples

  • Hoc salsum est; hoc adūstum est; hoc lautum est parum; illud rēctē: iterum sīc mementō.

    This is too salty; this is burnt; this isn’t washed enough; that one is right: remember to do it so again.Ter. Ad. 425–426

See also salt, sweet, sour, bitter, tasty, witty.

SourcesLewis & Short: salio

Plautus, Casina 222. Terence, Adelphoe 425–426.
